description:
The go to podcast for women leaders who want to grow in their relationship with God!!
Not feeling confident in distinguishing God’s voice? Are responsibilities consuming your time and leaving you with little or not enough time for God? Is fear stopping you from doing what God is asking of you? Have you been feeling stuck and don’t know how to move forward?
Luv, I’ve been looking for you, and I am so glad you’re here.
Deep Intimacy With God is for women leaders who desire a deeper relationship with God but struggle with hearing His voice, trusting His direction, and consistently making time for Him.
Here, you’ll learn how to hear God’s voice with confidence, grow closer to Him, trust His leading, and walk in obedience—without neglecting the responsibilities and purpose He has entrusted to you.
You’ll be empowered to overcome fear, distractions, inconsistency, and overwhelm so you can stop second-guessing God, trust Him more deeply, and confidently live out your God-given purpose.
Hi luvs, I’m Shardell—a mother, entrepreneur, lover of purpose, and lover of deep intimacy with God.
As a woman who wears many hats, I know what it feels like to love God and still struggle to consistently make quality time for Him. I’ve tried doing things my way, hiding behind my responsibilities, and doing just enough to feel like I was staying connected—going to church when I could, reading a verse a day, praying when I had time, and serving when I was needed.
But instead of feeling close to God, I often felt overwhelmed, distracted, and unsure.
I kept wondering, “Am I really hearing God?”
I didn’t want to miss His voice or find myself outside His will. I wanted more than simply doing Christian things. I wanted a real relationship with God. I wanted to know His heart, recognize His voice, trust His direction, and experience the deep intimacy with God I had been longing for.
Everything began to change when I stopped trying to fit God into whatever time I had left and began creating a lifestyle that made room for Him—a lifestyle that worked with the life He had actually called me to live.
As I learned to consistently make time for God, my intimacy with Him grew. And as my intimacy grew, so did my confidence in hearing His voice, trusting His direction, and walking in obedience.
Now, I want to help other women leaders experience that same transformation.
So if you’re ready to stop striving, stop second-guessing God’s voice, and stop wondering if you’re missing God, you’re in the right place.
It’s time to create a lifestyle that makes room for God—one that helps you grow closer to Him, hear His voice with confidence, trust His leading, and faithfully walk in the purpose He has given you.
Open your ear, open your heart, and let’s grow closer to God together.

title: THIS Kind of Menopause
author: Rebecca Cooper
description:
How can STEM-led organisations retain brilliant talent and create workplaces where experienced
women can thrive?
This podcast series explores *menopause in STEM* workplaces, with a focus on helping leaders
retain experienced women and build more supportive, inclusive organisations.
Across ten practical, thought-provoking episodes, explore why menopause is a business, leadership
and talent-retention issue, and what leaders can do about it.
Discover why experienced women may reduce their hours or leave, how menopause affects everyone
differently, and how to create an environment where people feel supported without having to share
more than they wish. Learn how to have respectful, confidential conversations, make meaningful
workplace adjustments and challenge stigma. With honest stories, fresh perspectives and actionable
insights, the series explores how leaders, women and men alike, can drive lasting cultural change.
Designed especially for *women in STEM leadership* , this series will equip you to turn awareness into
action, support your people and help retain the experience and expertise STEM needs.
*THIS Kind of Menopause* is all about feeling informed, prepared and empowered to have the kind of
menopause that’s seen as the next chapter of life, not a burden, something to dread, or a career
limiting life stage. It’s also a time to be kind to ourselves and that starts with talking about our
experiences and learning to advocate for ourselves.
Combining workplace guidance, statistics and personal stories, the series’ central message is that
menopause does not make women less capable. With greater awareness, better conversations and
thoughtful support, STEM organisations can retain valuable expertise and enable women to continue
thriving throughout their careers.
*Press play and discover how leadership can make a difference.*
*About Rebecca Cooper*
﻿Rebecca Cooper is a certified menopause coach and corporate menopause trainer with 20 years of
experience in HR. With first-hand experience of an early menopause, she is committed to enabling
STEM-led organisations retain experienced talent by creating menopause-inclusive workplaces.
Through menopause awareness training, leadership development, policy guidance and coaching
Rebecca supports individuals and organisations navigate the menopause transition with honesty,
practical support and kindness.

Nothing Silent is hosted by three people who have each built something from the ground up.

•	What top investors look for before they write a check

description: Caring Directly is a podcast that features the patients of Direct Primary Care physicians.You may be wondering what is a Direct Primary Care physician and so let me paint a picture for you.Before medicine became dominated by non-physicians, a doctor was able to directly care for their patient. These physicians cared for everyone as an individual being able to see their patients without being booked for months out or worrying if a patient's insurance would cover the care they recommended. In today's world of healthcare, many are still shocked that physicians all over the nation are once again able to deliver this type of care. This care is now called Direct Primary Care or DPC.  Take a listen to these fellow Americans share their DPC stories and you might even feel inspired to go find yourself your very own Direct Primary Care Doctor.

title: Minted
author: shfwa@samiahrafnirob.com
description:
Minted tells the true stories of money. Each episode, host Nirob takes one coin, one currency, one bubble, or one fraud — the first coins of ancient Lydia, the paper money that travelled from China to the world, the tulip mania that ruined a nation, the scheme that bears Charles Ponzi's name — and rebuilds it: the money, the people, the scheme, the crash, and what it taught the world about value and trust.

From the medieval bankers to Isaac Newton at the Royal Mint, from the South Sea Bubble to the Great Crash of 1929, from Weimar's hyperinflation to the invention of Bitcoin, Minted is about the strange, powerful thing we all use and few of us understand — money. Meticulously researched, honest about what is documented and what is legend. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new story every week

title: The Machine
author: ogpxm@samiahrafnirob.com
description:
The Machine tells the true stories behind the computers and the people who built the digital world. Each episode, host Nirob takes one machine, one inventor, or one breakthrough — Babbage's unbuilt engine, Ada Lovelace's first program, the room-sized ENIAC, the transistor, the internet, the smartphone, artificial intelligence — and rebuilds it: the inventors and programmers who made it, the struggle to make it work, the moment it switched on, and the world it created.

From punched cards to microprocessors, from the first programmable computer to the World Wide Web, from video games to machines that learn, The Machine is about the astonishing, accelerating story of computing — how machines were built, how they were programmed, and why the digital revolution is one of the greatest transformations in human history. title: Canvas
author: cmbuxwb@samiahrafnirob.com
description:
Canvas tells the true stories behind the world's great art. Each episode, host Nirob takes one artwork, one theft, or one forger — the Mona Lisa lifted from the Louvre in 1911, a Dutch painter who sold fake Vermeers to the Nazis, the 1990 Boston heist that has never been solved, the amber room that vanished in the Second World War — and rebuilds it: the artist, the work, the crime or the fraud, the discovery, and the meaning we attach to the beautiful.

From Michelangelo forging an antique as a young man to the modern market of counterfeit masterpieces, from the Nazi looting of Europe to the most expensive painting ever sold, Canvas is about the strange, secret life of art — how it is made, how it is stolen, how it is faked, and why a piece of canvas and pigment can be worth a fortune, a life, or a war. author: AudioBooks
description:
Tales of War by Edward Plunkett.

It was written for a political rather than artistic purpose, but because it was painfully inspired from life (and death) and because it is written by a great writer, it is far more than just a curio. It also crosses more than once into the fantastic realm, which is partly why it is of interest to readers of Dunsany's classic fantasy works. This special expanded edition adds a pair of previously uncollected war-related stories from the same time "One More Tale" and "La Dernire Mobilisation," plus a new introduction written especially for this volume by Dunsany scholar Darrell Schweitzer."

We’ve been told there are places too dark and dangerous, too wild and irrational, to ever acknowledge...let alone explore. Turns out, that’s where the real party is.

Sex, Death & Olive Oil is a nine month journey down into the forbidden territories of the soul. Your guide through the shadowlands is Contessa Domenica, professional Dominatrix and deviant extraordinaire.

Along the way you will hear from a merry band of tricksters who offer rather thrilling - and sometimes disconcerting - alternatives to the terribly unimaginative norms we’ve been expected to swallow. We are making steak from the sacred cows of an overculture that is, quite frankly, on the way out.

This is an initiation.

title: Stand By For Crime
author: Logic Media
description:
Step back into the gritty, neon-lit streets of 1950s Los Angeles with Stand By for Crime, an unheralded gem of classic radio drama that’s well worth a second listen.

If you loved the "just the facts" realism of Dragnet or the hard-hitting style of Gangbusters, this show is right up your alley. Forget the over-the-top melodrama of early radio—Stand By for Crime trades cheap thrills for a grounded, "day at the office" feel, taking you along for the ride as reporters and cops tackle the city's underbelly.

Follow Chuck Morgan (played by Glen Langen), a sharp, believable news anchor at KOP radio. When his pal, Lieutenant Bill Miggs of the police force, tips him off to hot crime news, Chuck and his quick-witted "Gal Friday," Carol Curtis (Adele Jurgens), dive headfirst into the case. Together, the trio rubs shoulders with all types of characters—mostly on the shady side of the street.

Why you should tune in:
🎙️ Solid Storytelling: The dialogue is tight, the plots are engaging, and the old-school repartee is strictly enjoyable.
🎙️ Real-Life Chemistry: The crackling dynamic between Chuck and Carol isn't just good acting—Glen Langen and Adele Jurgens were husband and wife in real life, having met on the set of The Treasure of Monte Cristoin 1949!
🎙️ Classic Noir Vibe: A perfect bridge between the golden age of radio and the modern true-crime genre.

Stand By for Crime may have been left for dead by history, but it’s a classic that deserves a spot in your queue.

Subscribe, tune in, and stand by for crime!

He founded FD Capital in 2018 and has since built out Exec Capital, NED Capital and Accountancy Capital alongside SMF Capital, working with boards, investors and regulated firms across the UK on senior and board-level appointments. title: Beyond the Injury: Understanding Serious
author: thomas edward
description:
Beyond the Birth is an informative and compassionate podcast dedicated to exploring birth-related injuries, medical negligence concerns and the challenges families may face when a baby experiences harm during pregnancy, labour, delivery or immediately after birth. The series aims to help parents understand complex medical and legal issues in accessible language while recognising the emotional impact that unexpected complications can have on an entire family.Each episode examines topics such as birth-related brain injuries, cerebral palsy, Erb’s palsy, shoulder dystocia, sub-galeal haemorrhage and trauma associated with instrumental delivery.

The discussions explore how medical records, labour monitoring, delivery decisions and independent medical opinions may help clarify what happened and whether the standard of care provided warrants further investigation.For parents seeking answers about a child's birth injury, birth trauma solicitors can provide information about the legal considerations involved, including how medical evidence is reviewed and how potential negligence claims are assessed.

The series highlights the importance of obtaining appropriate advice without assuming that every birth complication necessarily involves negligence.Beyond the legal questions, the podcast explores the realities of caring for a child with additional needs, accessing rehabilitation, planning for future care and navigating the emotional uncertainty that can follow a difficult birth. It also considers the importance of accountability, clear communication and ensuring that families have the information they need to make informed decisions.Through educational discussions, practical explanations and anonymised illustrative scenarios, Beyond the Birth seeks to empower families with knowledge, encourage thoughtful questions and explain the options that may be available when concerns arise. The series reflects the compassionate, evidence-focused approach associated with Cian O’Carroll Solicitors while making clear that each family's circumstances and legal options are unique.

We believe that knowledge empowers. By breaking down the “why” behind cancer care and giving space to expert insight and lived experience, Cancer Explained aims to support better conversations, reduce uncertainty and help listeners feel less alone on their cancer journey.

title: Four Questions
author: Ayin Press
description:
Welcome to Four Questions, a podcast from Ayin Press about the power and art of questioning. 
At the heart of the Passover seder lie four questions: deceptively simple yet endlessly prismatic, they embody the ever-evolving Jewish tradition of inquiry. Four Questions draws on this sacred technology to stage a series of expansive and interdisciplinary conversations between artists, philosophers, activists, and teachers from distinct worlds. In each episode, two people meet through the vulnerable act of asking and answering four open-ended questions. Through a textured landscape of language, music, and silence, each question is revealed as a doorway, an invocation to the unknown. Rather than interviews, these conversations are intimate encounters whose themes reach across traditions and time spans—touching art, science, religion, theater, politics, and beyond. 
The show features guests such as multidisciplinary artist Cannupa Hanska Luger, Rabbi Jericho Vincent, philosopher Báyò Akómoláfé, Rabbi Nate DeGroot, writer adrienne maree brown, theater director Zhailon Levingston, and many more. 
At a time when so much media is transactional and reductive, Four Questions offers a glimpse of another kind of discourse. Grounded in Jewish wisdom, yet reaching far beyond it, Four Questions brings together diverse thinkers for wide-ranging conversations that explore the act of questioning as a spiritual, artistic, and universal practice.

Intuitive Relationship & Marriage Coach Susan Ortolano goes beneath surface-level communication advice to explore the wounds, beliefs, protective patterns, and relationship dynamics quietly shaping how you show up with one another.

This is an inside-out exploration of marriage that goes deeper than the relationship advice you typically hear. You’ll gain insight into what is happening beneath your struggles, understand why your patterns persist, and learn practical ways to transform how you communicate, navigate conflict, rebuild trust, deepen intimacy, and consciously care for your partnership.

You’ll also come to understand Susan’s core, game-changing marriage philosophy: Marriage Success is an Inside Job™ and discover how changing the way you relate to yourself, your partner, and the challenges between you can transform your entire marriage.

For founders, investors, operators, and anyone curious how great businesses actually work.

title: Raising Her Different
author: Sedona Wise
description:
**Raising Her Different**
What if we questioned some of the things we've always been taught?
*Raising Her Different* is a podcast about motherhood, self-reflection, relationships, and the world we're raising our children in.
From breaking generational patterns and navigating family dynamics to questioning the messages we send young girls about confidence, consent, self-worth, and what it means to be a woman, we explore the things that shape us and the things we may want to do differently.
Some conversations are deep. Others are about everyday life, changing times, and the little things that make us stop and think.
This isn't about having all the answers or getting everything right. It's about being willing to reflect, challenge old assumptions, learn as we go, and make more conscious choices about what we pass on to the next generation.
Because raising her differently starts with being willing to look at ourselves, too.
**Honest conversations. New perspectives. Room to grow.**

title: My Moonlight Secret
author: Ainsley Bay | Romantasy, Shifter Romance author
description:
A FREE werewolf romance audiobook delivered as a daily podcast.
Coy Slate is a massive, soft-hearted werewolf from the West Virginia backwoods who has never sat in a lecture hall, never had a real friend, and never needed to pass for human. Then he follows his girlfriend Maya to college. Now he's got a rugby pitch to dominate, a drama class he can't stop thinking about, a sorority girl who doesn't take hints, and a full moon that doesn't care about midterms.
Maya is the only one on campus who knows what he is. She's also the only one who can teach him what intimacy means, and the only one who can talk him down when the beast wants out. But the more Coy shines, the harder it gets to keep his secret and her heart safe.
Packed with human/werewolf romance, big-hearted beast and fiercely loving heroine, possessive jealousy, hidden identity, claiming and mate bonds, college chaos, and all the heat you crave, this dual-POV serial delivers a new chapter of secrets, spice, and suspense every morning. No Audible subscription required.
Set in the world of A Forest of Earth and Moon, with the Slate family along for the ride.
Perfect for fans of: shifter romance, paranormal romance audiobooks, new adult romance, college romance, romantasy, Sarah J. Maas, Wolfsong, Teen Wolf, urban fantasy
A new chapter. Every day. For free. From Arcane Heart Studio.

title: Camper Opkoper Utrecht
author: Camper Opkoper Utrecht
description:
Welkom bij de podcast van Camper Opkoper Utrecht, dé plek voor iedereen die meer wil weten over het verkopen, inkopen en waarderen van campers. Of je nu een ervaren camperbezitter bent of voor het eerst jouw camper wilt verkopen, onze podcast biedt waardevolle informatie, praktische tips en deskundig advies.
Bij Camper Opkoper Utrecht draait alles om een eenvoudige, betrouwbare en transparante camperverkoop. In onze afleveringen bespreken we onderwerpen zoals de actuele campermarkt, factoren die de waarde van een camper bepalen, belangrijke aandachtspunten bij verkoop en manieren om jouw camper verkoopklaar te maken.
Daarnaast delen we handige inzichten over verschillende campermodellen, onderhoud, technische controles en veelgemaakte fouten tijdens het verkoopproces. Zo helpen we luisteraars om goed geïnformeerde beslissingen te nemen en hun camper met vertrouwen te verkopen.
Onze podcast is geschikt voor iedereen die geïnteresseerd is in campers en graag meer wil leren over de wereld van camperinkoop.
Luister mee met Camper Opkoper Utrecht en ontdek hoe je jouw camper eenvoudig en zonder onnodige zorgen kunt verkopen.
Bezoek onze website voor meer informatie over camperinkoop en onze dienstverlening:
https://camperopkoperutrecht.com/

title: Tea Talk with Coach Carolyn
author: Carolyn Ramona Hantz
description:
Carolyn was fired from her first job before the business even opened, and the lesson that came from it shaped a 46 year federal career. Her mother once said, "Don't dress for the job you have, dress for the job you want." 
In this episode, Carolyn unpacks what that really means: not clothing, but identity, preparation, and becoming ready before the opportunity arrives. She reflects on her path from a GS-2 legal clerk to 16 years as a Senior Executive, and leaves you with one question: Are you showing up as who you are today, or who you're becoming?

title: History That Shouldn't Be Real

description: Podcast DescriptionWhat if the strangest stories you've ever heard actually happened?Welcome to History That Shouldn't Be Real, hosted by Nathaniel Brooks, the podcast that uncovers the most bizarre, unbelievable, mysterious, and extraordinary moments in human history.From ancient civilizations and forgotten inventions to impossible coincidences, unusual wars, mysterious disasters, and historical figures who defied expectations, every episode takes you deep into a true story that sounds almost too incredible to believe.Why did medieval courts put animals on trial? How did a soldier continue fighting decades after World War II ended? And how did one man survive two atomic bombs?With immersive storytelling, fascinating historical research, and surprising discoveries, Nathaniel Brooks explores the moments that prove reality can be stranger than fiction.History That Shouldn't Be Real — because the truth is already unbelievable.This podcast is created with the assistance of artificial intelligence. title: Thriving Practice Podcast w/ Brian Wright
author: Brian Wright
description:
Where doctors, practice owners, office managers, treatment coordinators, reps and more come to master transformational leadership, high-performing culture, innovative treatment and case acceptance strategies, new patient acquisition, and elite patient experience hospitality to modernize, grow and scale their practice(s).


Are you a dentist, orthodontist or another type of doctor practice owner looking to scale your practice, increase production and lead a high-performing team without burning out? Do you want to make more money and work less? Do you want to increase efficiency, cash flow and profit? Do you want to wake up daily and have more fun, retain and/or attract high level talent? Interested in innovative strategies that will increase your case acceptance, treatment conversion and same day starts? Do you want to learn advanced Ritz-Carlton hospitality skill-sets to transform your patient experience and grow your new patients through more new patient referrals? Interested in unique marketing ideas for increased new patient acquisition?  Want to grow your Invisalign practice through better case acceptance, marketing, patient compliance and profitability? 


If you answered, "yes" to any of the above ... Welcome to The Thriving Practice Podcast. The ultimate dental, orthodontic and doctor practice owner podcast 

for practice management, marketing, sales, and transformational leadership. Whether you run a solo private practice, a multi-location dental or orthodontic group, or a growing dental startup, this show provides actionable strategies into five categories to help you achieve all of your goals. We call them, "The Five to Thrive:" Leadership, Culture Sales, Hospitality & Marketing. This show combines them all together to help you to streamline operations, increase sales, transform the patient experience, boost profitability, and build a culture that retains top talent.


We break down real-world solutions for the biggest challenges facing modern dental and orthodontic practices, including:


  • Practice Growth & Profitability: Proven frameworks to increase case acceptance, optimize fee schedules, and drive net revenue.
  • Dental Marketing & Patient Acquisition: SEO, local advertising, social media strategies, and high-converting reception workflows to get more high-value patients in the chair.
  • Team Leadership & Culture: Transition from tactical manager to practice CEO. Learn how to recruit, onboard, and retain associate dentists, hygienists, and front desk staff.
  • Systems & Operational Efficiency: Automate administrative bottlenecks, refine scheduling, and implement modern digital workflows to eliminate stress.
  • Mindset & Entrepreneurship: Overcome the isolation of practice ownership, master negotiation, and build long-term business wealth.
